Audgātra(prayoga)
śr. manual on the duties of the Udgātṛ priest in the various sacrifices like Atyagniṣṭoma, Uktha, Ṣoḍaśī etc. (list of 31 sacrifices given in MD. 1146). For details see individual titles under Udgātṛprayoga.
Adyar PL. p. 32 (Agniṣṭoma) (Sarvapṛṣṭha). Alph. List Beng. Govt. p. 22. Ānandāśrama 26. Baroda 393 (Prayogas of Udgātṛ, Prastotṛ, Pratihartṛ an. Subrahmaṇya). 1327. 6383 (a. (Agniṣṭoma). 6778 (b) (inc.). 6981 (b) (containing all stotras). 8839. 9784 (a. (inc.. 10367 (Bṛhaspatisavana, Bahiṣpavamāna). Burnell 25a Gov. Or. Libr. Madras 14. Hz. 623 (Agniṣṭoma). 644 (Vājapeya). IO. 408. 426 (Ukthya an. Atirātra). 4720 (beginning same a. in MD. 1145 Somaudgātra). Mad. Uni. R. A. S. 7 (b) (Pauṇḍarīka). MD. 1146 (Atyagniṣṭoma an. 30 other sacrifices). MT. 961 (a.. 1200 (inc.). 2413 (a. (inc.). Oppert I. 3388. 3959. II. 5925. 10115. R. A. Sastri II. p. 208. Viśvabhāratī 3047 (b).
--Āśval. Burnell 24b.
--Drāhyā. Baroda 6975 (Agniṣṭoma). Br.. 55. Burnell 23b. 25a. [Page100-a.

Audgātrapaddhati
Mādh. śr. by Rāmakṛṣṇa Āvasa Nānā Bhāi, son of Tripāṭhi Rāmadāsa. AS. p. 34. IM. 4945 (inc.). 4946 (inc.).
Pt.. Chow. Ser. 81 (ii).

Audgātraprayoga
name of a chapter of Sāyaṇa's Yajñatantrasudhānidhi (See IO. 377). Burnell 25a. IO. 377.

Audgātraprayoga
by Puruṣottama Bhaṭṭa, son of Devarājārya. Baroda 393. 6977 (c). BC. 141. See also NCC. II. p. 335b, Ud. prayoga.

Audgātramantramālikā
śr. BORI. 333 of 1883-84. BORI. D. I. i. 432. BP. p. 283. D. p. 363.

Audgātraratnākara
by Sadārāma, son of Deveśvara. BISM. thi. 162. IM. 4949 (inc.). IO. 409 (fr.).

Audgātrasāman
śr. Bomb. Uni. 586. BORI. 334 of 1883-84. BORI. D. I. i. 433. BP. p. 283. D. p. 363.

Audgātrasārasaṅgraha
name of Rudraskanda's Bhāṣya on Drāhyā. śr. sūtra.
See Oxf. 379b. 380a.

Audgātrasomasūtra
Drāhyā. Rep. Raj. & C. I. p. 3.

Audgāhamāni
ancient authority on gṛh. Q. in Jaiminīya gṛh. sūtra (18th Khaṇḍa) an. in Gobhila gṛh. sūtra III. 10. 7. 13. See also Śg. II. 4. [Page100-b]
